evaluations.note: 12 on the reference machine (2026-10-07; 16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre instead of evaluating the point again, 30 before the HPO data held the free energy and the Cauchy stress, 16 before the neighbour lists were exact). BFGS reaches the upper bound RCUT2B = 6.0 at eval 7 (1.015561e-01, the best), takes the one-sided gradient there (evals 8-9), re-evaluates the bound (10), takes the gradient again (11-12) and ends on its objective-delta test (status "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached"; COMPLETED until 2026-10-07). Example 05, the same search with the parametric cohesive-energy script, runs to MAXEVAL = 30 instead. Whether BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation of the clamped bound depends on the sign of the ~1e-13 relative re-evaluation noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation, so the count is not pinned (evals_tol 18: 0..30, see tolerance_rationale); best loss, components and RCUT2B do not depend on it.

tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The evaluation count is not deterministic across machines: the optimum is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0 (eval 7), and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation. The run ends after 12 evaluations on the reference machine (2026-10-07, 3 repeated runs identical; 16 before each finite-difference gradient took the loss at its point as its centre instead of evaluating the point again); it ran to MAXEVAL = 30 with the energies without entropy, as example 05 does. evals_tol 18 accepts 0..30: it was 14 (2..30 around 16) and was raised only to keep MAXEVAL = 30 accepted around 12. Both endings are accepted: DLIB:BFGS's objective-delta test, "DLIB:BFGS: FTOL_ABS reached" (FTOL_ABS is 1e-7 by default), and MAXEVAL, "DLIB:BFGS: MAXEVAL reached" (both ended COMPLETED until every HPO driver recorded why it ended, 2026-10-07).
